Optimization Insights & Recommendations

Synthesize findings into actionable recommendations for load balancing and grid optimization.

Actionable Recommendations

Incentivize Off-Peak Charging

Implement aggressive dynamic pricing discounts during Off-Peak hours and high renewable availability windows to shift load away from peak periods.

Highway Capacity Expansion

Prioritize adding fast-charging units (50kW+) at Highway locations which experience the highest queue lengths and wait times.

Smart Queue Management

Introduce priority booking systems for high-capacity vehicles (Buses/Trucks) to prevent them from causing bottlenecks during medium/high traffic density periods.

Renewable Integration Optimization

Pair dynamic pricing algorithms closely with local weather forecasts to maximize the utilization of grid renewables when the ratio is optimal.
